# Rayyan Abrar

> Rayyan Abrar builds websites, online stores, booking platforms and AI apps for businesses. Based in Lahore, Pakistan, working remotely with clients worldwide. Available for freelance projects and full-time roles.

## Work

- [Advanced Power Solutions](https://aps.com.pk/): E-commerce website for an industrial engineering firm in Pakistan (switchgear, generators, UPS systems, compressors), with an admin panel, user accounts, a cart and quote requests. Next.js, Tailwind. 2025.
- [Gull Swiss Limousine & Tours](https://www.gullswisslimousine.com/): Booking website for a limousine and chauffeur company in Switzerland, in English, German, French and Italian. Customers book transfers and tours and pay online with Stripe; the owner manages bookings, customers and blog posts from an admin panel. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe. 2026.
- [Sellwavy](https://sellwavy.com/): Multi-tenant e-commerce platform where each merchant runs a themed storefront on its own subdomain or custom domain, with Stripe Connect payouts and Stripe Billing subscriptions. Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL. 2025.
- [Chef Aboud Küche](https://chefaboud1.vercel.app/en): Catering restaurant website for a Berlin-based chef, in English, German and right-to-left Arabic. Next.js. 2025.
- [Naro](https://naro-web.vercel.app): AI video studio that turns a written script into a finished narrated video, shipped as a Windows app. Python, Google Gemini. 2026.
